enrichment__abcd.description: enrichment_abcd - Development App, Development DB, Development SAP, dev environment, staging app, test database, sandbox system. This field categorizes assets into specific development or testing environments, often used to distinguish non-production resources from operational systems.

entra_devices__accountEnabled.description: entra_devices_accountEnabled - true, false, enabled, disabled, active, inactive. Indicates whether a device is currently authorized and active within the Microsoft Entra ID tenant for management and authentication purposes.

entra_devices__deviceId.description: entra_devices_deviceId - GUID, device identifier, unique device ID, hardware ID, serial number, UUID. A unique identifier assigned to a device by the Microsoft Entra ID service, used to track and manage specific hardware assets.

entra_devices__deviceOwnership.description: entra_devices_deviceOwnership - Company, Personal, corporate, employee-owned, BYOD, personal device. Specifies the ownership model of the device, distinguishing between company-managed assets and personal devices brought into the workplace.

entra_devices__isCompliant.description: entra_devices_isCompliant - true, false, compliant, non-compliant, policy violation, audit pass, audit fail. Indicates whether the device meets the security and compliance policies enforced by the organization's management system.

entra_devices__isManaged.description: entra_devices_isManaged - true, false, managed, unmanaged, enrolled, not enrolled. Determines if the device is currently under the control and management of the organization's IT infrastructure.

entra_devices__managementType.description: entra_devices_managementType - MDM, MAM, hybrid, mobile device management, mobile application management, unified endpoint management. Describes the specific management framework or technology used to control and secure the device.

entra_devices__trustType.description: entra_devices_trustType - AzureAd, ServerAd, Workplace, trusted, untrusted, enterprise, personal. Defines the trust relationship level between the device and the identity provider, affecting access permissions and security posture.

intune__azureADDeviceId.description: intune_azureADDeviceId - GUID, Azure AD device ID, Entra ID device ID, unique device identifier, device object ID. The unique identifier for a device within the Microsoft Azure Active Directory ecosystem, used for enrollment and policy application.

intune__complianceState.description: intune_complianceState - compliant, configManager, inGracePeriod, compliant, non-compliant, grace period, remediation required. Indicates the current status of the device's compliance with Intune policies, including whether it is fully compliant or in a remediation grace period.

intune__deviceEnrollmentType.description: intune_deviceEnrollmentType - androidAOSPUserOwnedDeviceEnrollment, appleBulkWithUser, appleBulkWithoutUser, user-owned, bulk enrollment, managed enrollment, BYOD, MDM. Specifies the method and type of enrollment used to register the device with Intune, distinguishing between user-owned and corporate-managed scenarios.

intune__id.description: intune_id - GUID, Intune device ID, unique device identifier, device object ID, hardware ID. The unique identifier assigned by Microsoft Intune to a specific device, used for tracking, reporting, and applying policies.

intune__imei.description: intune_imei - IMEI, International Mobile Equipment Identity, mobile device serial number, hardware ID, device serial. The unique 15-digit identifier for mobile devices, used to track and manage cellular and mobile hardware assets.

intune__isEncrypted.description: intune_isEncrypted - true, false, encrypted, unencrypted, BitLocker enabled, BitLocker disabled, encryption status. Indicates whether the device's data storage is currently protected by full-disk encryption technology.

intune__managedDeviceOwnerType.description: intune_managedDeviceOwnerType - company, personal, unknown, corporate, employee-owned, BYOD, unmanaged. Specifies the designated owner of the device within the Intune ecosystem, helping to categorize assets for support and compliance.

ldap_computers__description.description: ldap_computers_description - Computer description, object description, account description, purpose, notes, usage, SSO account, Azure storage account. Provides human-readable notes or descriptions about the computer's purpose, such as its role in SSO or Azure storage, often containing warnings about deletion.

ldap_computers__domain.description: ldap_computers_domain - PRIME, PRIMPROD, WORKGROUP, domain name, forest name, AD domain, Active Directory domain. Identifies the Active Directory domain to which the computer account belongs, crucial for network segmentation and authentication.

microsoft_defender_api__av.description: microsoft_defender_api_av - MS Defender, Microsoft Defender, antivirus, AV, endpoint protection, threat protection. Indicates the presence and type of antivirus software provided by Microsoft Defender on the endpoint.

sentinelone__agentVersion.description: sentinelone_agentVersion - version number, agent version, software version, build number, release version. Specifies the current version of the SentinelOne agent installed on the device, critical for ensuring compatibility with security updates.

sentinelone__detectionState.description: sentinelone_detectionState - full_mode, install_to_dynamic, slim_mode, detection mode, agent mode, installation type. Describes the operational mode or installation type of the SentinelOne agent, affecting its resource usage and detection capabilities.

sentinelone__domain.description: sentinelone_domain - PRIME, PRIMPROD, WORKGROUP, domain name, forest name, AD domain, SentinelOne domain. Identifies the Active Directory domain associated with the SentinelOne agent deployment, used for grouping and management.

sentinelone__id.description: sentinelone_id - GUID, SentinelOne device ID, unique device identifier, hardware ID, device object ID. The unique identifier assigned by SentinelOne to a specific device, used for tracking and managing endpoint security.

sentinelone__isUpToDate.description: sentinelone_isUpToDate - true, false, up-to-date, outdated, latest version, previous version. Indicates whether the device's security agent is running the latest version available from the vendor.

sentinelone__siteName.description: sentinelone_siteName - Dev-S-App, Dev-S-DB, Dev-S-SAP, site name, environment name, application site, development site. Identifies the specific site or environment within the SentinelOne management console where the device is located.

category.description: category - device type, asset type, classification, type, device class, asset class, hardware type. The high-level grouping: Server, Workstation, Laptop, Desktop, VM, Network Device, IoT, Printer, Mobile Device.

confidence.description: confidence - score, quality, accuracy, certainty, reliability, data quality. How reliable the asset data is (0-100%).

data_source.description: data_source - source, integration, provider, discovered by, origin. Which system discovered this asset: CrowdStrike, Intune, ServiceNow.

data_source_category.description: Category of the data source: EDR, CMDB, Directory Service, Network Scanner, Cloud Platform.

first_seen.description: first_seen - discovered, created, added, first discovered, initial discovery, when added. When the asset was first found by AssetAtlas.

fqdn.description: fqdn - fully qualified domain name, full hostname, full DNS name, complete hostname, full domain name. The complete name with domain: server01.corp.company.com

geo_cities.description: geo_cities - city, geo city, geolocation city, IP city, location city, metro area, municipality, town. Cities associated with the asset's public IP addresses, derived from DB-IP geolocation lookup. Accuracy is typically metro-area level (~50 km). Multiple cities possible when an asset has public IPs in different locations.

geo_countries.description: geo_countries - country, geo country, geolocation country, IP country, location country, country code, ISO country, nation, territory. Countries associated with the asset's public IP addresses, derived from DB-IP geolocation lookup. Values are country names (e.g. "United States", "Germany"). Multiple countries possible when an asset has public IPs in different regions.

geo_regions.description: geo_regions - region, geo region, state, province, subdivision, geolocation region, IP region, location region, territory. Regions or states associated with the asset's public IP addresses, derived from DB-IP geolocation lookup. Uses first-level administrative subdivisions (e.g. "California", "Bavaria", "New South Wales").

hostname.description: hostname - computer name, machine name, device name, server name, workstation name, PC name, node name, system name, NetBIOS name, DNS short name, DNS name. The unique name identifying a computer on a network (without domain suffix). Examples: SERVER01, LAPTOP-JOHN

ip.description: ip - IP address, network address, IPv4, IPv6, internet protocol, host IP, device IP, layer 3 address, network layer address. The logical network address. Examples: 192.168.1.100, 10.0.0.5

ip_private.description: ip_private - private IP, internal IP, RFC1918, private address, LAN IP, internal address, non-routable IP. IP addresses in private ranges (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x, CGNAT 100.64.x, IPv6 ULA). Classified by the pipeline using Python ipaddress.is_global.

ip_public.description: ip_public - public IP, external IP, internet IP, globally routable IP, WAN IP, public address. IP addresses reachable on the public internet. Classified by the pipeline using Python ipaddress.is_global.

ip_type.description: ip_type - IP type, IP classification, address type, network type, private or public. Summary classification of an asset's IPs: private_only (all internal), public_only (all internet-routable), mixed (both), none (no IPs).

ipam_location.description: Location information from IP Address Management system based on network subnet assignments.

last_seen.description: last_seen - last active, last updated, recent, latest, last observation, last check-in. When the asset was most recently seen.

location.description: location - site, building, floor, rack, room, data center, datacenter, DC, rack location, physical location, where. Where the device is physically placed.

mac.description: mac - MAC address, hardware address, physical address, ethernet address, NIC address, layer 2 address, data link address, burnt-in address, network interface card address. The hardware identifier (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format).

mac_vendor_enriched.description: mac_vendor_enriched - MAC vendor, NIC vendor, OUI vendor, OUI lookup, network card manufacturer. The vendor from MAC address OUI prefix lookup.

manufacturer.description: manufacturer - vendor, make, brand, OEM, hardware vendor, producer, company name. Who made the hardware: Dell, HP, Cisco, Apple, Lenovo.

model.description: model - model number, product name, hardware model, device model, SKU, part number. The specific product: PowerEdge R740, MacBook Pro, ThinkPad X1.

os_eol_date.description: os_eol_date - EOL date, end of life date, end of support date, OS EOL date, support end date, retirement date, sunset date. The date when the asset's operating system reaches end of life and stops receiving security updates. Derived from OS normalization and EOL reference data during the pipeline.

os_eol_status.description: os_eol_status - EOL status, end of life, end of support, supported, unsupported, lifecycle. Whether the OS is still supported.

os_is_lts.description: os_is_lts - LTS, long term support, is LTS, OS LTS, LTSC, long term servicing, stable release, extended support. Whether the asset's operating system is a Long Term Support release. LTS releases receive extended security updates and have longer support lifecycles. Derived from OS normalization during the pipeline.

os_normalized.description: os_normalized - operating system, OS, platform, system software, Windows, Linux, macOS, Ubuntu, OS version, OS type, system type. What software runs the computer.

owner.description: owner - assigned to, user, responsible, contact, department, team, custodian, manager, accountability, cost center, who owns, ownership, responsible party. Who is accountable for this asset.

sn.description: sn - serial number, serial, service tag, asset tag, hardware ID, chassis serial, product serial, S/N, id, identifier, unique number. The manufacturer tracking number on the device sticker.

subcategory.description: subcategory - subtype, detailed type, specific classification, secondary category. Granular classification like Web Server or Gaming Laptop within the main category.

user_field.description: user_field - user field, custom field, user defined, user data, custom attribute, user note, user label. A free-text field that can be set per asset by users for custom categorization, notes, or metadata not captured by other fields.
